desc: Ideation: split p at '*', use KMP + prev/next occurrence arrays, uniform handling of empty parts
Implement KMP prefix function and matcher returning all start indices of a pattern in s
Split p into A, B, C at the two '*' positions; handle empty parts as matching at every position 0..n
Build prevA[k] = latest A-start ≤ k and nextC[k] = earliest C-start ≥ k arrays (size n+1)
For each B-occurrence start b: a = prevA[b - len(A)], c = nextC[b + len(B)]; candidate = c + len(C) - a; track min
Test against all four examples plus edge cases: p="**" (answer 0), empty A/C combos, overlapping occurrences, no-match; verify O(|s|+|p|) complexity
